op.description: Operation type: 'replace' for updating name, 'add' for adding members, 'remove' for removing members

path.title: Path
path.description: Property path to modify. Valid values: '/name' for workspace name, '/members' for team members

value.title: Value
value.description: New value for replace/add operations. For 'replace' with '/name', provide the new workspace name. For 'add' with '/members', provide the member email. Not used for 'remove' operations.

operations.title: Operations
operations.description: List of patch operations to apply to the workspace. Each operation modifies a specific property.

href.title: Href
href.description: Link to typeforms in the workspace

count.title: Count
count.description: Number of typeforms in the workspace

account_id.title: Account Id
account_id.description: ID in the ULID format of the account where workspace belongs to

tools.name: upload_video
tools.description: Initiate a video upload to Typeform by obtaining a signed upload URL. Use this action to prepare for uploading a video file to a specific form field. After receiving the upload_url, use it to upload the actual video file via a PUT request.

form_id.title: Form Id
form_id.description: Unique form identifier where the video will be attached

field_id.title: Field Id
field_id.description: Field ID where the video media belongs within the form

language.title: Language
language.description: ISO 639-1 format language code for automatic transcription (e.g., 'en' for English, 'es' for Spanish)

upload_url.title: Upload Url
upload_url.description: Temporary signed URL for uploading video file via PUT request

transcode_status.title: Transcode Status
transcode_status.description: Current transcoding status of the video
